// ═══ START EXPERIENCE ═══
let started=false;
function startExperience(){
  if(started)return; started=true;
  var ld=document.getElementById('loader');
  ld.classList.add('fade');
  setTimeout(function(){ld.style.display='none';},1500);
  setTimeout(startMusic,400);
}

// ═══ MUSIC PLAYER ═══
var TRACK_NAMES=["Selene — Ethereal Butterfly","Selene — Ethereal Butterfly I","Selene — Ethereal Butterfly II","Selene's Quiet Halo","Selene's Hollow Light"];
var TRACKS=5, curTrack=0, isPlaying=false, audioReady=false;

function getAudio(i){return document.getElementById('track'+i);}

function startMusic(){
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  a.volume=parseFloat(document.getElementById('vol-slider').value);
  a.currentTime=0;
  var p=a.play();
  if(p) p.then(function(){isPlaying=true;updatePlayerUI();}).catch(function(e){console.log('Autoplay:',e);});
  a.onended=function(){nextTrack();};
  a.ontimeupdate=function(){updateProgress();};
  a.onloadedmetadata=function(){document.getElementById('t-dur').textContent=fmtTime(a.duration);};
  audioReady=true;
}

function updatePlayerUI(){
  document.getElementById('track-name').textContent=TRACK_NAMES[curTrack].toUpperCase();
  document.getElementById('track-num').textContent='Track '+(curTrack+1)+' / '+TRACKS;
  document.getElementById('play-btn').textContent=isPlaying?'⏸':'▶';
}

function updateProgress(){
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  if(!a.duration)return;
  var pct=(a.currentTime/a.duration)*100;
  document.getElementById('prog-bar-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
  document.getElementById('t-cur').textContent=fmtTime(a.currentTime);
}

function fmtTime(s){
  if(!s||isNaN(s))return'0:00';
  var m=Math.floor(s/60),sec=Math.floor(s%60);
  return m+':'+(sec<10?'0':'')+sec;
}

function togglePlay(){
  if(!audioReady){startMusic();return;}
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  if(isPlaying){a.pause();isPlaying=false;}
  else{a.play().catch(function(){});isPlaying=true;}
  updatePlayerUI();
}

function switchTrack(n){
  var prev=getAudio(curTrack);
  prev.pause(); prev.onended=null; prev.ontimeupdate=null; prev.currentTime=0;
  curTrack=((n%TRACKS)+TRACKS)%TRACKS;
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);
  a.volume=parseFloat(document.getElementById('vol-slider').value);
  a.currentTime=0;
  a.onended=function(){nextTrack();};
  a.ontimeupdate=function(){updateProgress();};
  a.onloadedmetadata=function(){document.getElementById('t-dur').textContent=fmtTime(a.duration);};
  if(isPlaying)a.play().catch(function(){});
  updatePlayerUI();
  document.getElementById('prog-bar-fill').style.width='0%';
  document.getElementById('t-cur').textContent='0:00';
}
function nextTrack(){switchTrack(curTrack+1);}
function prevTrack(){switchTrack(curTrack-1);}
function setVol(v){var a=getAudio(curTrack);a.volume=parseFloat(v);}
function seekAudio(e){
  var a=getAudio(curTrack);if(!a.duration)return;
  var rect=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  a.currentTime=((e.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width)*a.duration;
}

// ═══ VIDEO ═══
function playVid(i){
  var vid=document.getElementById('vplay'+i);
  var ov=document.getElementById('vov'+i);
  if(vid.paused){
    vid.muted=true;
    vid.play().catch(function(){});
    ov.style.opacity='0'; ov.style.pointerEvents='none';
  } else {
    vid.pause();
    ov.style.opacity='1'; ov.style.pointerEvents='auto';
  }
}

var cur=document.getElementById('cur'),cur2=document.getElementById('cur2');
var mx=0,my=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cur.style.left=mx+'px';cur.style.top=my+'px';});
setInterval(function(){cur2.style.left=mx+'px';cur2.style.top=my+'px';},90);

// ═══ DOWNLOAD ═══
function dlSite(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  var blob=new Blob([document.documentElement.outerHTML],{type:'text/html'});
  var a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download='selene_ethereal_butterfly.html';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
  setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);a.remove();},1200);
}
function copyAddr(el){
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.textContent.trim()).catch(function(){});
  var orig=el.textContent; el.textContent='✓ Copied!';
  setTimeout(function(){el.textContent=orig;},2200);
}

// ═══ BUTTERFLIES ═══
var bCv=document.getElementById('btfly-cv'),bCtx=bCv.getContext('2d');
var butterflies=[],mPts=[];
function resizeB(){bCv.width=window.innerWidth;bCv.height=window.innerHeight;}
resizeB(); window.addEventListener('resize',resizeB);

var STARS=[];
for(var si=0;si<200;si++) STARS.push({x:Math.random()*3200,y:Math.random()*2200,r:.3+Math.random()*1.9,spd:.001+Math.random()*.004,op:Math.random()});

function Btfly(x,y,big){
  this.x=x||Math.random()*bCv.width; this.y=y||Math.random()*bCv.height;
  this.vx=(Math.random()-.5)*.7; this.vy=(Math.random()-.5)*.7;
  this.angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2; this.turn=(Math.random()-.5)*.055;
  this.sz=big?(9+Math.random()*16):(4+Math.random()*13);
  this.phase=Math.random()*Math.PI*2; this.wSpd=.05+Math.random()*.09;
  this.life=big?(.5+Math.random()*.4):(.25+Math.random()*.65);
  this.decay=big?(.0012+Math.random()*.002):(.0007+Math.random()*.0015);
  var idx=Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
  var hues=[[45,85,68],[28,88,58],[220,75,62],[50,50,95]];
  this.h=hues[idx][0]+(Math.random()-.5)*18; this.s=hues[idx][1]; this.l=hues[idx][2];
  this.glow=this.sz>10;
}
Btfly.prototype.update=function(){
  this.angle+=this.turn+(Math.random()-.5)*.022;
  this.vx+=Math.cos(this.angle)*.028; this.vy+=Math.sin(this.angle)*.028;
  this.vx*=.965; this.vy*=.965;
  this.x+=this.vx; this.y+=this.vy;
  this.phase+=this.wSpd; this.life-=this.decay;
  if(this.x<-45)this.x=bCv.width+45;
  if(this.x>bCv.width+45)this.x=-45;
  if(this.y<-45)this.y=bCv.height+45;
  if(this.y>bCv.height+45)this.y=-45;
};
Btfly.prototype.draw=function(){
  var w=Math.abs(Math.sin(this.phase));
  bCtx.save();
  bCtx.translate(this.x,this.y);
  bCtx.rotate(Math.atan2(this.vy,this.vx)+Math.PI/2);
  bCtx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,this.life*.88);
  var col='hsla('+this.h+','+this.s+'%,'+this.l+'%,';
  if(this.glow){
    var gr=bCtx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,this.sz*4.5);
    gr.addColorStop(0,col+'.32)'); gr.addColorStop(1,col+'0)');
    bCtx.fillStyle=gr; bCtx.beginPath(); bCtx.arc(0,0,this.sz*4.5,0,Math.PI*2); bCtx.fill();
  }
  bCtx.fillStyle=col+'.9)';
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(-this.sz*.56*w,-this.sz*.36,this.sz*.66*w+1,this.sz*.44,-.35,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(this.sz*.56*w,-this.sz*.36,this.sz*.66*w+1,this.sz*.44,.35,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  var col2='hsla('+(this.h+18)+','+this.s+'%,'+Math.min(100,this.l+14)+'%,';
  bCtx.fillStyle=col2+'.74)';
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(-this.sz*.44*w,this.sz*.28,this.sz*.5*w+1,this.sz*.32,.22,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(this.sz*.44*w,this.sz*.28,this.sz*.5*w+1,this.sz*.32,-.22,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.fillStyle='hsla('+this.h+',35%,90%,.92)';
  bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.ellipse(0,0,1.5,this.sz*.46,0,0,Math.PI*2);bCtx.fill();
  bCtx.restore();
};

for(var bi=0;bi<75;bi++){var nb=new Btfly();nb.life=Math.random()*.7+.2;butterflies.push(nb);}

document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){
  if(Math.random()>.52)butterflies.push(new Btfly(e.clientX+(Math.random()-.5)*22,e.clientY+(Math.random()-.5)*22,true));
  if(butterflies.length>115)butterflies.splice(0,8);
  mPts.push({x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,life:1,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.3,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*1.3-.35,sz:1.5+Math.random()*4.5});
});
document.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){
  var t=e.touches[0];
  for(var ti=0;ti<5;ti++)butterflies.push(new Btfly(t.clientX+(Math.random()-.5)*28,t.clientY+(Math.random()-.5)*28,true));
  if(butterflies.length>115)butterflies.splice(0,10);
},{passive:true});

(function bLoop(){
  var t=Date.now()*.001;
  bCtx.clearRect(0,0,bCv.width,bCv.height);
  STARS.forEach(function(s){
    var sx=s.x%bCv.width, sy=s.y%bCv.height;
    var op=Math.max(0,.18+Math.sin(t*s.spd*120+s.x)*.22);
    bCtx.beginPath();bCtx.arc(sx,sy,s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    bCtx.fillStyle='rgba(255,248,218,'+op+')';bCtx.fill();
  });
  var orbCols=['rgba(212,175,55,','rgba(255,140,0,','rgba(123,79,160,','rgba(68,136,255,'];
  for(var oi=0;oi<4;oi++){
    var ox=bCv.width*(.14+oi*.24)+Math.sin(t*.24+oi*1.9)*(bCv.width*.06);
    var oy=bCv.height*.5+Math.cos(t*.19+oi*2.1)*(bCv.height*.15);
    var r=55+oi*20;
    var og=bCtx.createRadialGradient(ox,oy,0,ox,oy,r);
    og.addColorStop(0,orbCols[oi]+'.058)'); og.addColorStop(1,orbCols[oi]+'0)');
    bCtx.fillStyle=og; bCtx.beginPath(); bCtx.arc(ox,oy,r,0,Math.PI*2); bCtx.fill();
  }
  mPts=mPts.filter(function(p){
    p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.life-=.044;
    var g=bCtx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,p.sz);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(212,175,55,'+p.life+')'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,0,0)');
    bCtx.fillStyle=g; bCtx.beginPath(); bCtx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.sz,0,Math.PI*2); bCtx.fill();
    return p.life>0;
  });
  butterflies=butterflies.filter(function(b){b.update();b.draw();return b.life>0;});
  if(butterflies.length<65)butterflies.push(new Btfly());
  requestAnimationFrame(bLoop);
})();

function typewriter(cfg){
  var ti=0,ci=0,deleting=false;
  var el=document.getElementById(cfg.id);
  if(!el)return;
  function tick(){
    var txt=cfg.texts[ti];
    if(!deleting){el.textContent=txt.slice(0,ci+1);ci++;if(ci===txt.length){setTimeout(function(){deleting=true;tick();},3400);return;}}
    else{el.textContent=txt.slice(0,ci-1);ci--;if(ci===0){deleting=false;ti=(ti+1)%cfg.texts.length;setTimeout(tick,380);return;}}
    setTimeout(tick,deleting?16:45);
  }
  tick();
}
twData.forEach(typewriter);

// ═══ AMBIENT GLOW PULSE ═══
setInterval(function(){
  var f=document.createElement('div');
  f.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at '+(25+Math.random()*50)+'% '+(25+Math.random()*50)+'%,rgba(212,175,55,.055),transparent 55%);pointer-events:none;z-index:9982;animation:_gf .9s ease-out forwards';
  var s=document.createElement('style');s.textContent='@keyframes _gf{0%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}';
  document.head.appendChild(s);document.body.appendChild(f);
  setTimeout(function(){f.remove();s.remove();},1000);
},5500+Math.random()*6000);

</script>
